name: MediaLens
description: Read-only media library analyzer for movies and TV shows, with detailed HDR, Dolby Vision, audio, codec, subtitle, and hardware compatibility analysis.

paths.name: App Data
paths.description: Persistent MediaLens application data and SQLite database. Keep this path when upgrading or recreating the container.

paths.name: Movies
paths.description: Read-only path to your Movies library. The container path /media/movies is used by the MediaLens setup wizard.

paths.name: TV Shows
paths.description: Read-only path to your TV Shows library. The container path /media/tv is used by the MediaLens setup wizard.

variables.name: Automatic Scanning
variables.description: Automatically detect newly added or changed media files.

variables.name: File Stability Seconds
variables.description: Number of seconds a new or changed file must remain stable before MediaLens analyzes it.

variables.name: Reconcile Interval Minutes
variables.description: How often MediaLens reconciles the library for missed changes.
